attachment.content:
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring remote agent, set up automated tasks, create a cron job for Claude Code, or manage their scheduled agents/routines. Also use when the user wants a one-time scheduled run ("run this once at 3pm", "remind me to check X tomorrow").
- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).
TRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.
SKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.
- init: Initialize a new CLAUDE.md file with codebase documentation
- review: Review a pull request
- security-review: Complete a security review of the pending changes on the current branch

## 当前进展
- **阶段**: MVP 验证
- **核心假设**: KL 训练的预测器通过端到端梯度流捕获联合神经元交互，在高稀疏率下优于 BCE 的逐神经元独立目标
- **基础设施**: westd-34887, 2× RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (98GB, compute cap 12.0), gpu_ids=[0,1]
- **约束**: C001 — 只允许 cuda:0, cuda:1
- **实验**: 暂无，Agent 正在执行环境搭建 + 代码 scaffolding

## MVP 验证方案
**核心问题**: KL-trained predictor 在 50% model-level sparsity 下是否优于 BCE-trained predictor？

**设计**:
- 模型: Llama 3.1 8B, 冻结权重
- 预测器: rank-128 MLP (4096→128→14336), ~2.36M params/layer, Gumbel-sigmoid mask
- 条件 A: KL loss (output logits distillation)
- 条件 B: BCE loss (per-neuron binary targets)
- 校准数据: SlimPajama, batch_size=4, seq_len=2048, ~1K steps
- 稀疏率: 50% model-level (TEAL greedy allocation)
- 评估: WikiText-2 perplexity + C4 perplexity
- **Seeds: 3 per condition**, 两组可在 cuda:0 / cuda:1 并行

**Pass/Fail**:
- PASS: 3-seed 均值 KL ppl < BCE ppl，差距 ≥ 0.3 ppl
- SOFT PASS: 差距 < 0.3 ppl 但方向一致 → 加 seed 确认
- FAIL: KL ≈ BCE 或 BCE 更优 → 核心假设不成立，评估 pivot

- Reimplement SPON (bias vectors + KL training, ~1h on 2× GPU)

- KL vs BCE @ 40% sparsity (测 s² scaling prediction)

### [重要] TEAL 命名纠正
当前 `evaluate.py` 中 `teal_global_masks()` 实际实现是 predictor-score global top-k，不是原版 TEAL greedy allocation。MVP 阶段 KL/BCE 用相同 eval 逻辑公平比较没问题，但 registry spec 和论文中**不要标注 "TEAL greedy allocation"**，应标注为 "predictor-score global top-k" 或类似。

### [Phase 1 升级] BCE + Gumbel 改进
- BCE 需升级为 FastForward 风格加权版本（Phase 1 时做）
- Gumbel 温度初始值应为 τ=5→0.1（IDEA_BRIEF 规定），当前代码可能是 τ=1.0→0.1，MVP 后修正

### [Reviewer Warning] KL 归一化梯度信号 (2026-05-15)
- Reviewer 指出 kl_raw 在 quicktest 中单调递增（1.18→10.38），kl_norm≈8e-5 梯度信号可能太弱
- **Director 决策: 当前不改配方**——WikiText-2 PPL 是决定性指标
- 如果 3-seed KL PPL 明显差于 BCE (s42=44.21, s123=44.83, s456=42.54)，再考虑调归一化系数
- 备选方案: sqrt(vocab_size) 或 log(vocab_size) 作为分母替代 seq_len

## SPON 调研 (2026-05-15)

### SPON 方法
- 论文: "Resting Neurons, Active Insights" (arXiv 2512.12744)
- 机制: 每层注入 1 个 learnable input-independent bias vector 作为稀疏化后的 representational anchor
- 训练: **KL divergence** (distribution matching)，训练完成后 bias 可吸收进模型权重，**零推理开销**
- 效果: 50% sparsity 下一致优于 TEAL baseline
- 代码: 截至 2026-05-15 未找到公开代码仓库，需阅读论文全文获取超参数
- 参数量极低: 每层仅 hidden_dim 个参数

### 竞品格局
| 方法 | 训练目标 | 核心差异 |
|------|---------|---------|
| DejaVu/PowerInfer/TurboSparse | BCE predictor | 我们用 KL 是核心差异化 |
| ProSparse/TurboSparse | 替换激活函数 | 我们保留 SwiGLU 是优势 |
| MaskLLM | Gumbel Softmax mask | 验证了 Gumbel 方向可行性 |

### Phase 2 组合路径
KL Predictor 决定 mask → SPON bias vectors 补偿误差。两者互补：predictor 做稀疏决策，SPON 做误差修正。SPON 训练成本极低。

## 实验经验 (2026-05-15)

### MVP BCE 结果（3 seeds 高度一致）
- BCE 训练 batch_size=4，~25 min / 1000 steps (~1.5 sec/step)
- 3 seeds 训练指标：bce_loss 0.637-0.639, sparsity 0.551, 高度稳定
- ⚠️ 评估数据不可信：evaluate.py 在不同 eval 间被修改过（dense PPL 6.12 vs 27.96）。需用统一版本重跑（unified-bce-eval worker 处理中）

### [关键突破] KL 归一化 + Lagrangian 解决稀疏性坍塌
- **问题**: 原始 KL (batchmean) ~418 vs sparsity constraint ~1.2，3 个数量级差距 → sparsity 坍塌到 0
- **根因**: F.kl_div(reduction='batchmean') = sum / batch_size，但 KL 在 vocab 维度 (128k) 累加，绝对值天然很大
- **解决方案**: KL 再除以 seq_len（不除 vocab_size！除 vocab_size 会让 KL~1e-8 太小）
- **归一化后**: KL 从 ~418 降到 ~1.18（step 1），与 constraint ~0.1 同量级
- **Lagrangian 参数**: lambda_init=1.0, ×2.0 更新, 每 25 步, cap=1000, ±0.02 容忍带
- **结果**: sparsity 在 step 80 收敛到 0.504（target 0.5），lambda 稳定在 8
- **教训**: 端到端 KL 蒸馏中必须(1) 归一化 KL 到 per-token scale (2) 用自适应约束

### KL 训练显存与速度
- gradient checkpointing: bs=2 实测 29.5GB, bs=4 实测 ~88GB（95GB 卡刀刃运行但稳定）
- KL 模式代码已自动启用 gradient checkpointing
- gradient accumulation 修复: 原始代码有 loss 未 scale + step 计数 bug
- KL 单步 ~15-30s/step vs BCE 1.5s/step, 1000 steps KL 约 40 min

  relevance_to_us: "方法论启示：KL divergence不仅可作为训练loss，还可作为layer-wise重要性指标。我们可用per-layer KL分析哪些层的sparsity对output distribution影响最大"

# =============================================================================
# Direction 3: SPON和类似的learnable bias correction for sparsity
# =============================================================================

- title: "Fast Forward: Accelerating LLM Prefill with Predictive FFN Sparsity"
  authors: [Aayush Gautam, Mukul Gagrani, Junyoung Park, Mingu Lee, Chiris Lott, Narasimha Reddy]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2602.00397"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "Predictor + error compensation双组件架构——与SPON的bias correction思路互补"
  key_finding: "组合三个组件：(1) lightweight expert predictor选择high-importance neurons，(2) error compensation network修正sparsity误差，(3) layer-wise sparsity scheduler分配计算。50% FFN sparsity下达到1.45x prefill加速"
  relevance_to_us: "与我们的方案最可比：都用predictor做activation sparsity。我们的差异在于用KL loss训练predictor而非BCE，且不需要额外的error compensation网络（KL loss本身应该能减少distribution shift）"

- title: "Amber Pruner: Leveraging N:M Activation Sparsity for Efficient Prefill in Large Language Models"
  authors: [Tai An, Ruwu Cai, Yanzhe Zhang, Yang Liu, Hao Chen, Pengcheng Xie, Sheng Chang, Yiwu Yao, Gongyi Wang]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2508.02128"
  category: background
  role: "N:M structured activation sparsity——hardware-friendly的sparsity pattern"
  key_finding: "Training-free的top-k策略在linear projection层内确定N:M activation masks，在2:4/4:8/8:16多种ratio下有效，可与W8A8量化组合"
  relevance_to_us: "如果我们的predictor输出改为N:M structured pattern而非unstructured binary mask，可获得更好的hardware加速。值得作为future work"

# =============================================================================
# Direction 4: Predictor-based activation sparsity (TEAL, DejaVu, PowerInfer等)
# =============================================================================

- title: "Training-Free Activation Sparsity in Large Language Models"
  authors: [James Liu, Pragaash Ponnusamy, Tianle Cai, Han Guo, Yoon Kim, Ben Athiwaratkun]
  venue: ICLR 2025 (Spotlight)
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2408.14690"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "TEAL——我们的主要baseline，training-free magnitude pruning"
  key_finding: "对所有hidden states施加magnitude-based sparsity（不需训练），在40-50% sparsity下性能降低很小，Llama-2/3和Mistral 7B-70B上验证。50% sparsity下1.8x decoding加速"
  relevance_to_us: "TEAL用BCE度量sparsity mask质量（二元对错），我们的核心论点是：BCE只看neuron是否激活的对错，忽略了错误预测对output distribution的差异化影响。KL loss应该能让predictor学到'哪些neuron的错误预测对output影响更大'"

- title: "Deja Vu: Contextual Sparsity for Efficient LLMs at Inference Time"
  authors: [Zichang Liu, Jue Wang, Tri Dao, Tianyi Zhou, Binhang Yuan, Zhao Song, Anshumali Shrivastava, Ce Zhang, Yuandong Tian, Christopher Re, Beidi Chen]
  venue: ICML 2023
  year: 2023
  arxiv_id: "2310.17157"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "Predictor-based contextual sparsity的开创性工作——我们的直接对比对象"
  key_finding: "用两层MLP predictor预测每层的contextual sparsity pattern（哪些attention heads和MLP neurons可跳过），在OPT-175B上实现2x加速。Predictor用BCE训练"
  relevance_to_us: "DejaVu是predictor-based sparsity的baseline。其predictor用BCE训练——我们改用KL loss训练类似的predictor。关键差异：DejaVu在per-neuron level用BCE，我们在output distribution level用KL"

- title: "ShadowLLM: Predictor-based Contextual Sparsity for Large Language Models"
  authors: [Yash Akhauri, Ahmed F AbouElhamayed, Jordan Dotzel, Zhiru Zhang, Alexander M Rush, Safeen Huda, Mohamed S Abdelfattah]
  venue: EMNLP 2024
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2406.16635"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "DejaVu的改进——更好的predictor架构和sparsity pattern enforcement"
  key_finding: "Shadow predictor超越magnitude-based pruning，context-dependent评估attention head和neuron重要性。比DejaVu端到端精度提升15%，速度提升20%"
  relevance_to_us: "ShadowLLM改进了predictor架构但仍用BCE-style loss。我们的改进方向正交：不改predictor架构，改训练loss（BCE→KL）。两种改进可能互补"

- title: "SparseInfer: Training-free Prediction of Activation Sparsity for Fast LLM Inference"
  authors: [Jiho Shin, Hoeseok Yang, Youngmin Yi]
  venue: DATE 2025
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2411.12692"
  category: background
  role: "Training-free sign-bit predictor——极低开销的sparsity预测"
  key_finding: "仅比较input和weight的sign bits预测activation sparsity，无需训练。仅适用于ReLU-based LLMs，不适用SwiGLU"
  relevance_to_us: "不适用于SwiGLU模型（我们的目标），但其sign-bit方法的简洁性值得参考。SwiGLU缺乏天然sparsity证明trained predictor的必要性"

- title: "SVD Contextual Sparsity Predictors for Fast LLM Inference"
  authors: [Georgii Serbin, Kirill Koshkin, Zhongao Sun, Anastasiya Bistrigova, C.C. Korikov]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2026
  arxiv_id: "2603.14110"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "Training-free SVD-based sparsity predictor——用gate projection矩阵的SVD做预测"
  key_finding: "对ReGLU FFN的gate projection矩阵做truncation-aware SVD构建sparse pattern predictor，90% FFN sparsity下1.8x decoding加速，benchmark降低<1%"
  relevance_to_us: "虽然是training-free competitor，但focus在ReGLU（不是SwiGLU）且需要90%天然稀疏性。我们的方法在SwiGLU的50%目标sparsity下工作，使用场景不同"

- title: "CATS: Contextually-Aware Thresholding for Sparsity in Large Language Models"
  authors: [Donghyun Lee, Je-Yong Lee, Genghan Zhang, Mo Tiwari, Azalia Mirhoseini]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2404.08763"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "Contextual thresholding——不训练predictor，用统计threshold做sparsity"
  key_finding: "为每个MLP层计算SiLU(x)激活的percentile threshold做sparsification，50% sparsity下性能降低1-2%，无需fine-tuning。Mistral-7B和Llama2-7B上验证"
  relevance_to_us: "CATS直接在SwiGLU/SiLU模型上工作，是我们的直接competitor。但CATS是固定threshold不考虑input context，我们的trained predictor是input-dependent的，理论上更优"

- title: "R-Sparse: Rank-Aware Activation Sparsity for Efficient LLM Inference"
  authors: [Zhenyu Zhang, Zechun Liu, Yuandong Tian, Harshit Khaitan, Zhangyang Wang, Steven Li]
  venue: ICLR 2025
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2504.19449"
  category: background
  role: "Training-free rank-aware方法——利用input channel sparsity和SVD"
  key_finding: "用SVD分解将input channel sparsity映射到output，无需预测active channels。50% model-level sparsity下43%端到端加速"
  relevance_to_us: "Training-free baseline。如果R-Sparse在SwiGLU模型上效果很好，我们需要证明trained KL predictor的额外训练成本是值得的"

- title: "Efficient LLM Inference using Dynamic Input Pruning and Cache-Aware Masking"
  authors: [Marco Federici, Davide Belli, Mart van Baalen, Amir Jalalirad, Andrii Skliar, Bence Major, Markus Nagel, Paul Whatmough]
  venue: MLSys 2025
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2412.01380"
  category: direct-competitor
  role: "Predictor-free dynamic pruning for SwiGLU——直接针对SwiGLU的magnitude pruning"
  key_finding: "Predictor-free方案动态剪枝SwiGLU MLP层，配合LoRA adapter恢复精度。Phi-3-Medium上46%内存减少+40%吞吐提升"
  relevance_to_us: "直接针对SwiGLU的competitor。DIP证明SwiGLU的sparsity pattern难以预测（所以放弃predictor），我们的KL-trained predictor需要证明能克服这个挑战"

# =============================================================================

- title: "ReLU Strikes Back: Exploiting Activation Sparsity in Large Language Models"
  authors: [Iman Mirzadeh, Keivan Alizadeh, Sachin Mehta, Carlo C Del Mundo, Oncel Tuzel, Golnoosh Samei, Mohammad Rastegari, Mehrdad Farajtabar]
  venue: ICLR 2024
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2310.04564"
  category: background
  role: "ReLU替换SiLU获得天然sparsity——替代路线"
  key_finding: "用ReLU替换SiLU/GELU后continual pretraining，获得天然高稀疏性（>90%），推理计算减少3x"
  relevance_to_us: "替代路线：修改activation function vs 训练predictor。我们的定位：不需要修改pretrained模型架构，作为plug-in predictor在现有SwiGLU模型上工作"

- title: "Turbo Sparse: Achieving LLM SOTA Performance with Minimal Activated Parameters"
  authors: [Yixin Song, Haotong Xie, Zhengyan Zhang, Bo Wen, Li Ma, Zeyu Mi, Haibo Chen]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2406.05955"
  category: background
  role: "dReLU获得90%+ sparsity——activation function工程的极致"
  key_finding: "提出dReLU使LLM达到近90% sparsity同时保持SOTA性能，2-5x decoding加速"
  relevance_to_us: "与ReLU Strikes Back同一思路但更极端。我们不改activation function，这是差异化定位"

- title: "ProSparse: Introducing and Enhancing Intrinsic Activation Sparsity within Large Language Models"
  authors: [Chenyang Song, Xu Han, Zhengyan Zhang, Shengding Hu, Xiyu Shi, Kuai Li, Chen Chen, Zhiyuan Liu, Guangli Li, Tao Yang, Maosong Sun]
  venue: COLING 2025
  year: 2025
  arxiv_id: "2402.13516"
  category: background
  role: "Progressive sparsification——渐进式增加sparsity regularization"
  key_finding: "三步法：ReLU替换→progressive sparsity regularization（沿sine curve增强）→threshold shifting(FATReLU)。LLaMA2-7B达89.32% sparsity"
  relevance_to_us: "ProSparse的progressive training策略可参考：我们的KL predictor训练也可渐进式增加sparsity目标（已在Lagrangian约束中实现）"

- title: "Sparsing Law: Towards Large Language Models with Greater Activation Sparsity"
  authors: [Yuqi Luo, Chenyang Song, Xu Han, Yingfa Chen, Chaojun Xiao, Xiaojun Meng, Liqun Deng, Jiansheng Wei, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun]
  venue: arXiv
  year: 2024
  arxiv_id: "2411.02335"
  category: background
  role: "Activation sparsity的scaling law——理论基础"
  key_finding: "SiLU/SwiGLU的activation ratio随训练递增（变密），ReLU递减（变稀）。Sparsity对parameter scale不敏感，与width-depth ratio线性相关"
  relevance_to_us: "理论支撑：SiLU/SwiGLU模型天然不够稀疏（随训练变密），因此需要外部predictor/pruning来获得稀疏性——这是我们工作的motivation之一"

  authors: [Nobel Dhar, Bobin Deng, Md Romyull Islam, Xinyue Zhang, Kazi Fahim Ahmad Nasif, Kun Suo]

  relevance_to_us: "降低predictor复杂度的思路。如果我们的per-neuron KL predictor开销太大，可考虑cluster-level prediction"

现在 kl_norm 等于 kl_raw，所以训练损失处于合理的量级。看起来没问题，我来发布审查意见。
